# Mobile extension attributes

Jamf Pro mobile-device extension attributes — list/get/create/put/delete and copy/migrate. No SCRIPT input type (TEXT/POPUP/LDAP only). Computer EAs are under [extension attributes](/docs/docs/extension-attributes).

## Agent rules

- Do not invent SCRIPT for mobile EAs. Computer definitions are `extension_attribute*`.

## Facts

- List: `mobile_extension_attributes(filter?)` · `buddy mobile-extension-attribute list` — Summaries `{id, name, inputType, dataType, inventoryDisplayType}`
- Load: `mobile_extension_attribute(id=…)` / `mobile_extension_attribute(name=…)` · `buddy mobile-extension-attribute get` — Full Jamf JSON
- Create / update: `mobile_extension_attribute_create` / `mobile_extension_attribute_put` · `create` — TEXT/POPUP/LDAP only
- Delete: `mobile_extension_attribute_delete` · `delete` — One ID or a list
- Copy / migrate: `mobile_extension_attribute_copy` / `mobile_extension_attribute_migrate` — Upsert by name
- Mobile EAs have no SCRIPT, templates, or XML upload/download — use computer EAs for inventory scripts.
